environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'data-plane' with identical code deployed. The Lambda function URL resource policy specifies Condition with StringEquals on 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM', and the function URL configuration has AuthType: AWS_IAM. Callers must present a valid SigV4 signature from a principal listed in the function's resource-based policy. The pod's IRSA role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/enrichment-pod-role) is NOT listed in the Lambda function's resource-based policy — only the authorized frontend role is. Additionally, the EKS node group launch template specifies HttpTokens: required (IMDSv2 only) with a hop limit of 1, and the pod runs with a hostNetwork: false setting meaning the extra network hop from pod to node prevents IMDSv2 token retrieval. A Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy in the namespace restricts egress from pods labeled app=enrichment-svc to only port 443 destinations matching FQDN pattern '*.lambda-url.*.on.aws' and denies all other egress except kube-dns on port 53/UDP.

config.pod_network_mode: hostNetwork: false (extra hop blocks IMDSv2 token with hop_limit=1)
config.cilium_network_policy: egress restricted to *.lambda-url.*.on.aws:443 and kube-dns:53/UDP only
